d: Can Margie Cooper make it a clean sweep as she and Mark Hill head for the heart of Edinburgh in a 1980 MGB Roadster.
Actress Helen Flanagan asks Angus to sell some Corrie keepsakes and haute couture, while comedian Bobby Davro brings coins and sporting memorabilia.
The experts are entranced by a three-dimensional portrait of a Hindu goddess. Plus, they revive a birdwatcher's binoculars and a broken silver locket.
The team revive a rusty chrome calendar ornament. They restore a 1930s schoolbook from Trinidad and a sweet little wind instrument called an ocarina.
Workers manufacture toilets that massage and blow-dry. The Navy tests a pilotless helicopter. A jackhammer that doesn't cause the shakes is built.
The secrets behind keeping the cars of Daytona on the track for 24 hours of racing are revealed. The sweetest sugarcane is turned into Caribbean rum.
Giant sturgeons are farmed for the delicacy of Russian caviar. Workers create soccer cleats worn by the sport's greatest players.
Danish bomb squads find and dispose of thousands of World War II landmines. Weed eaters chop down growth with just a sliver of nylon.
Hunting for rare treasures, the team visit a colourful collection of Americana, a historic shipping warehouse, and a huge indoor flea market in Wales.
Modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard is in Staffordshire to get access to a private collection of a pub owner, who has been hoarding antiques for over half a century.
With Drew busy hunting for antiques, Paul heads to a classic car auction near the Malvern Hills. Paul sees big potential in a MGA 1600, even though it doesn't start up.

The boys mark the MGB's 60th anniversary in style by buying and fixing up one of these classic motors. But the upgrades come with hefty costs.
This BMW was more driver-focused and handled better than its contemporaries. Will Edd be able to resurrect a 1970s relic not started for two decades.
Mike is in the Pacific Northwest, where he has tracked down a true 'barn find': A Volvo Amazon 122 with a rally heritage. Ant is tasked with making it roadworthy.
Mike heads out to Poland to bag a Lamborghini Uracco. However, the price of this classic is rising due to Lamborghini's 50th anniversary, can Mike bag a bargain.
Saab 9-3. Mike wants a high performance car with an historic badge, but it's hard to find a Saab 9-3 Turbo at a good price. With tight margins will Edd have any room for manoeuvre.
Car dealing legends Mike and Ant are in their west coast workshop in the US, searching, buying, restoring, testing and selling more great motors in the American market.
MotoGP: Portugal Sprint Race. History will be made if Marc Marquez wins in Portugal and secures his 10th World Championship at one of the world's most spectacular circuits.
Peter And Cat / RAF Truck. Henry and Fuzz view an exquisite collection of military and civilian vehicles in Guildford. What will they sell to the drummer from a British rock band.
Henry and Fuzz sail over to the Isle of Wight. They meet Vince, a fanatical collector whose sheds are bursting with British and Japanese bikes.
Henry and Fuzz are overwhelmed by Nick from Brackley's military collection. They leave with a vintage rarity, but will they find a buyer for something so unique.
Henry and Fuzz rummage through David's hoard of Italian bikes in Norfolk. They're smitten by his Ducatis and his rare Mot Guzzis, but just what will he sell.

Opalton Boulder Crew are going to the Winton Opal Festival, Slim Pickings are finally at White Peg, and the Mooka Boys have driven to Coober Pedy.
John, Steve, Deano and Simon move four huge 90-ton dumper trucks from South Wales to Tilbury docks. Plus, Arran takes modular homes from the Hull manufacturers to a Bedford school.
When a mummy is discovered on an abandoned boat, investigators struggle to explain where it came from. Jeremy Wade reveals what happened.
Jeremy Wade reveals the new deep-sea discoveries that might prove the existence of the infamous giant squid. Is this underwater monster the legendary kraken.

Henry and Fuzz find a Triumph Terrier in Oxfordshire. Can they breathe life into this little legend and get it back on the road.

t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
d: The guys are in Gloucestershire, where they rummage through huge sheds full of junk. They unearth a coffee table and an interesting set of scales.
Angus helps Phil Daniels with 1960s and 70s goodies in his Yorkshire home. Then, he finds the 2012 Olympic torch in Colin Jackson's family home.
Animal Rescue And The Gold Haul. A charity needs cash to feed rescued animals. Can Angus raise a sizable sum? A widow discovers her late husband's collection is worth a fortune.
Natasha Raskin Sharp and James Braxton start their hunt in Wales. On the way they uncover hidden musical talents and find out what's in James' jug.

A big-top circus tent is erected as high as a building in less than 36 hours. Plus, Japanese workers create handcrafted guitars.
A 700-year-old tree is turned into a Japanese drum. A tech factory builds thousands of cars while staying green. Two ingredients are made into pasta.
